rules.justification: Ingestion pipelines must account for 100% of input records to avoid silent data loss.
Mode S hex addresses are unique 24-bit identifiers; duplicate records indicate multi-path interference or feed errors.

rules.predicate: -90.0 <= lat <= 90.0 and -180.0 <= lon <= 180.0 and lat is not None and lon is not None
rules.justification: Spatial queries and indexing fail on invalid or missing coordinates.

rules.expected_result: Values within realistic physical flight bounds
rules.justification: Unrealistic kinematic parameters indicate telemetry sensor faults or corrupt frames.

rules.predicate: seen >= 0.0 and seen_pos >= 0.0; warning if seen > 300.0
rules.expected_result: Non-negative sensor latencies; stale telemetry flagged
rules.justification: Negative latencies violate causality; high latency indicates stale position.

rules.predicate: provenance is not None and provenance.source_url and provenance.raw_acquisition_utc
rules.justification: Governed data assets must preserve immutable audit provenance.

rules.predicate: all mandatory fields present and strictly conformant to data dictionary types
rules.expected_result: Zero schema mismatch or malformed types
rules.justification: Malformed types crash downstream analytical engines and serialization endpoints.

rules.expected_result: Physical consistency between surface state flag and kinematic values
rules.justification: Transponder reporting surface state while cruising at 35,000 ft indicates corrupt telemetry.

rules.predicate: dataset_id != schema_version and semantic versioning followed
rules.expected_result: Unambiguous separation between dataset asset and schema definition
rules.justification: Prevents catastrophic confusion between specific dataset releases and schema contracts.

rules.predicate: licence == 'Open Data Commons Open Database License (ODbL) v1.0' and attribution statement present
rules.justification: Prevents copyright and licensing violations during downstream data reuse.
